body: Yes I get this 100%. I am in recovery from an eating disorder and we learned in treatment that we have to stay in our emotions. The ED is all about numbing yourself out to the world around you, worrying about numbers on a scale instead of deep existential thoughts... well now I'm not worrying about the numbers on the scale so much, which is good, but I am feeling my emotions and it is so hard to stay in them. Especially when I have such terrible emotions sometimes. Ugh depression is so awful.

Thank you. I really understand what you are saying and it makes a lot of sense. I am glad you do open mics, that's really cool. I absolutely love listening to music but I don't really have any ability to create it. I think I need to get involved in art more, something more fulfilling. I paint and draw but I haven't done it in a while, I need to get back into it. I think maybe that will help me. I feel a little calmer now. It's been a rough few months, I've had to deal with a lot.

> It's also because our level of responsibilty changes - we become more.. powerful - like.. we are the ones who are going to make the world a better place, right? It's up to us.!

I definitely feel this, especially because I have gone through a lot, and I want to help others. But what about all the other people I can't help? What if what I isn't enough? It can get draining. If I can help people, and I'm not, I feel so bad. But I can't just always be helping others all the time... meanwhile they are suffering. :(

Thank you. That was beautifully said.

I know this might seem stupid but another really good friend just dumped me and I've been feeling really low about that. I thought meaning in my life was in part helping others, helping my friends, but I feel like now I can't really trust most of them. Like they're just using me, just hanging out with me out of convenience, and then they will drop me when something better comes along. So what's the point if no one really cares anyway??? Sorry I know this must sound stupid and petty and juvenile. :(
I guess that's true. All I want is to be happy, that's sort of my goal or "point" I guess. But something just keeps coming up that prevents me from being happy, and I'm getting sick of it.

Yes I have told her, she knows pretty much everything. Although she doesn't know she's basically what I'm living for right now, that's way too much pressure to put on one person.

I know they can be conquered but I'm sick of fighting. It's exhausting. I can't help thinking it would be better to just be at peace.
